item.title: God Speaks from the Whirlwind: The Glory of the Lord (Job 38–42)
item.description: In the closing chapters of the book of Job, the Lord Himself speaks. After long silence, painful questioning, and deep suffering, God answers Job—not with explanations, but with revelation. Speaking from the whirlwind, the Lord displays His sovereign power over creation, humbles His servant, rebukes false counsel, and restores Job in compassion and grace.
